## Institutions

<a id="estonia-national"></a>

### Rahvusarhiiv

`repository` · [Website / directory](https://www.ra.ee/)

The National Archives of Estonia is a countrywide research route. Its genealogy guidance distinguishes the AIS archival description system from Saaga digitized family-history sources. Use historical manor and parish names as well as present places; registration may be required for viewing. County pages in this directory are browsing aids, not invented county repositories.

Links: [https://ais.ra.ee/](https://ais.ra.ee/) · [https://www.ra.ee/dgs/explorer.php?web=saaga](https://www.ra.ee/dgs/explorer.php?web=saaga)

Holdings: The institutional guide describes birth, death and marriage sources, revision lists, personal files, court files and repression-related files; locality and series coverage varies.

Source: [https://www.ra.ee/vau/index.php/en/page/article/index?menuId=16](https://www.ra.ee/vau/index.php/en/page/article/index?menuId=16) · 2026-11-02 · institutional-genealogy-guide-read
